Blocks.Section: How can I avoid Job Deduplication?
SectionPath: How can I avoid Job Deduplication?
Blocks.Text:
If a customer is using Job Wrapping and Premium Job Posting API, there could be a risk that these jobs are duplicated.
Between Basic and promoted jobs, our system prioritizes jobs that are promoted.
It is recommended that customer uses either API or XML Feed based jobs to avoid duplication

Blocks.Section: Our customer cannot renew their closed job via Premium Job Posting. How can I do that?
SectionPath: Our customer cannot renew their closed job via Premium Job Posting. How can I do that?
Blocks.Text: You can RENEW only an open job. If the Job is CLOSED, a new request for the job needs to be sent with jobPostingOperationType: CREATE

Blocks.Section: What are the reasons a Basic Job doesn’t appear on LinkedIn?
SectionPath: What are the reasons a Basic Job doesn’t appear on LinkedIn?
Blocks.Text: In some cases, we may require certain types of jobs to be promoted on LinkedIn. Jobs that require promotion may include jobs by companies with generic names (such as “Confidential Company”) or jobs from search and staffing companies. These limits are designed to prevent abuse, improve product quality, and increase transparency while ensuring that job seekers have access to the best possible opportunities. Please note that LinkedIn reserves the right to require promotion of jobs.

Blocks.Section: Many of our customer jobs are getting posted to LinkedIn via XML feed and Job Wrapping. What happens when the same jobs get posted via Premium Job Posting?
SectionPath: Many of our customer jobs are getting posted to LinkedIn via XML feed and Job Wrapping. What happens when the same jobs get posted via Premium Job Posting?
Blocks.Text: It depends on the integration.

Blocks.Section: Many of our customer jobs are getting posted to LinkedIn via XML feed and Job Wrapping. What happens when the same jobs get posted via Premium Job Posting?
SectionPath: Many of our customer jobs are getting posted to LinkedIn via XML feed and Job Wrapping. What happens when the same jobs get posted via Premium Job Posting?
Blocks.Text:
For the partners who have integrated with LinkedIn's Apply Connect program, the promoted jobs posted via /simpleJobPosting API will close out existing scraped and wrapped jobs
For the remaining partners, whichever job was posted first will stay up. If a job is posted via Job Wrapping first, the Simple Job Posting (SJP) job does not post if it has the same unique partner identifier. In such cases, the task status response outlines the following error message:

"Trying to create a job with the same partnerIdentifier already exists! Dropping the duplicate job posting creation request. JobId: 123456789, partnerIdentifier: {partner=urn:li:jobPostingPartner:{id}, partnerJobCode=Test123456}."

Blocks.Section: Can a job posted via the Job Posting API replace old or backfilled jobs in the Recruiter dashboard?
SectionPath: Can a job posted via the Job Posting API replace old or backfilled jobs in the Recruiter dashboard?
Blocks.Text: No, if you have used your job slots you will receive an error message indicating that there are none remaining. You are unable to replace to backfill jobs

Blocks.Section: How do I know if the location provided will be standardized correctly?
SectionPath: How do I know if the location provided will be standardized correctly?
Blocks.Text: Answer: We do not have a utility tool or an API that can help validate a location match. However, refer to the Help Article for few guidelines to ensure improved accuracy for location matching.

Blocks.Section: Are alternate location postings supported by all type of PJP contracts such as job posts, job slots? Are customers charged differently?
SectionPath: Are alternate location postings supported by all type of PJP contracts such as job posts, job slots? Are customers charged differently?
Blocks.Text: Yes, they are supported by all types of PJP contracts, and each multiplexed job takes up an additional slot for job slots. For FP4P, customer will need to set separate budgets for each job.

Blocks.Section: When a candidate applies to a posting with alternate locations, is the location of origin communicated back to the ATS?
SectionPath: When a candidate applies to a posting with alternate locations, is the location of origin communicated back to the ATS?
Blocks.Text: For jobs with alternateLocations, we will mirror career site experience and provide application back to original jobpostingID. If customer is trying to tie applicants to specific cities, customer should include a question in application flow to capture preferred location.

Blocks.Section: Is there any difference in terms of performance between a single free/premium posting with three alternate locations, versus three individual free/premium postings with a single location?
SectionPath: Is there any difference in terms of performance between a single free/premium posting with three alternate locations, versus three individual free/premium postings with a single location?
Blocks.Text: There should not be a performance difference.

Blocks.Section: How can we get contract and company details of a customer ? Is there a way for LinkedIn to provide this information?
SectionPath: How can we get contract and company details of a customer ? Is there a way for LinkedIn to provide this information?
Blocks.Text:
A customer needs to manually provide these details and the partner ATS should provide support to take both LinkedIn Contract ID and Company ID as input.
Dependent on ATS / Job Distributor this may be done through the UI or manually through support teams
Below Help Article links can be shared to help customers find their Contract and Company ID:

For Contract ID refer to this help center
For Company ID refer to this help center

Blocks.Section: Provisioned Applications response is not recorded due to some error, how can we obtain client secret?
SectionPath: Provisioned Applications response is not recorded due to some error, how can we obtain client secret?
Blocks.Text: In this case, you need to check if the application is created or not using uniqueForeignId, if the application is not created you can request it again with the same uniqueForeignId otherwise you need to create a new application with a new uniqueForeignId.

Blocks.Section: How to update `validJsSdkDomains` in the customer application?
SectionPath: How to update `validJsSdkDomains` in the customer application?
Blocks.Text: Provisioning APIs allow partners to update customer applications, This will override the existing list of JavaScript SDK domain names with the list of domains in the request body of this POST call.

Blocks.Section: If the widget callback fails in partner ATS, how can we get the customer contract id?
SectionPath: If the widget callback fails in partner ATS, how can we get the customer contract id?
Blocks.Text: You can ask customers to opt in again with the widget. Unless "update customer integration" call goes through API job postings will not be active for customers.

Blocks.Section: What can I do in a scenario where we cannot fix locations and other fields for jobs created via API?
SectionPath: What can I do in a scenario where we cannot fix locations and other fields for jobs created via API?
Blocks.Text:
If you are able to post to LinkedIn and can find the location on Bing Geo, you should be able to post via the API
If there is a valid location not mapping properly, we can map it to post if it is valid. Please reach out to LinkedIn Customer Support ltsatsintegrations@linkedin.com for the same
We cannot create custom mapping; the client must supply the right location info/string

Blocks.Section: How can we fix default job poster related issues?
SectionPath: How can we fix default job poster related issues?
Blocks.Text:
In such cases, the task status response outlines this error message: "Caller is not authorized to access the jobs for contract: urn:li:contract:189990
Troubleshooting steps will be

Ensure Customer has configured Job Poster correctly.
Ensure poster email is the primary email on LinkedIn profile and seat holder on the above contract
Admin should check if the default poster is a valid seat holder (sometimes this is not updated if someone is removed from the Recruiter dashboard)

Blocks.Section: How can I help customers when their Job Slots are full?
SectionPath: How can I help customers when their Job Slots are full?
Blocks.Text:
This issue may arise when customers are manually posting jobs in Recruiter or using Job Wrapping while also using a Job Posting Partner
An admin can check job slot availability within the Recruiter dashboard product settings
Please refer to the following help center article

Blocks.Section: How can I surface feedback on the Premium Job Posting to LinkedIn?
SectionPath: How can I surface feedback on the Premium Job Posting to LinkedIn?
Blocks.Text: If the Partner has questions on the integration, please ask them to reach out via the partner support form and copy their LinkedIn Business Development and Partner Engineering point of contact directly.

Blocks.Section: How can I allocate Job Slots between Recruiters?
SectionPath: How can I allocate Job Slots between Recruiters?
Blocks.Text: As an admin, you can determine how job slots are allocated across your recruiting team. Click here to learn more about managing job slots and the ability to disable manual job posting for users.

Blocks.Section: Can I completely disable manual job posting into job slots from LinkedIn Recruiter dashboard and allow ATS to manage it?
SectionPath: Can I completely disable manual job posting into job slots from LinkedIn Recruiter dashboard and allow ATS to manage it?
Blocks.Text: Yes, this is possible. Ensure that your ATS is integrated with LinkedIn’s Premium Job Posting program and then follow the steps mentioned in the article here. To disable the functionality, select the Do not allow manual job postings option.

Blocks.Section: What would happen if we remove the default job poster?
SectionPath: What would happen if we remove the default job poster?
Blocks.Text: If the default job poster is removed from the contract after widget integration, Job postings via API will fail until you go through the widget opt-in process to select a new default job poster again.
